text: ポケモンって　むずかしいわ！

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a chatty way to bring it up as the thing you are about to comment on, like は with more feeling. ポケモンって = 'Pokémon, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end adds soft feeling to a statement and here sounds feminine. むずかしいわ = 'they're so difficult'.
